Messages.Body:
The French National Championship will be held from Friday September 28th to Sunday September 30th. (28/09/2012 - 30/09/2012) in Rennes.

The tournament will take place in the Maison de Quartier La Touche (www.mdqlatouche.com/)

Map : www.mdqlatouche.com/infos-pratiques/plan-dacces

The main post (in French) will be updated more regularily (www.veknfrance.com/forum/viewtopic.php?t=16792)

Another thread will be opened for the registration.

Friday

or

Prizes
HOW TO GO THERE

By car: once on the ring road of Rennes, wherever you're going, take the direction of Brest/Lorient. Leave at the Villejean exit et take direction of "Centre-ville". Continue on boulevard Saint-Jean-Baptiste de la Salle and the Rue de Brest until you come to a crossroad with a "Super U" shop you can't miss. At this crossraod, go left on the boulevard de Verdun. Take the boulevard de Verdun on 500 m. The entrance of the gated community where the Maison de quartier stand is on your right, right before the bus stop "La Touche". Park nearby and come by foot to the Maison de quartier.

On foot/subway/bus from the SNCF rail station:
- by subway: take the sub at the rail station, direction "Kennedy" et get off at the "Anatole France" station. From the exit, take the street that goes in the gated community that is on your left and follow it until you reach the Maison de quartier (100 m). It takes around 10 minutes (there is a metro every 2-4 minutes from monday to saturday, every 4 minutes on sunday)
- by bus: take line #2 in front of the station, direction "Grand Quartier" et get off at the "La Touche" stop. On your right when getting off the bus, go down the boulevard de Verdun on 20 m. The entrance of the gated community is on your left. It takes around 15 minutes to go there (a bus every 10 minutes during the week, every 20 minutes on saturday, every 45 minutes on sunday).

By foot/subway/bus from the airport of Rennes located at Saint-Jacques de la Lande: take bus #57 direction "République". At the "République" stop, take bus #2 or the subway as indicated above. It takes 40-50 additional minutes (a bus every 20 minutes from monday to saturday, every hour on sunday).

NB: The Rennes airport is not est quite badly-served and the tickets are expensive. You can also take a plane ticket to Nantes then come from Nantes by train.
